summary: Completed comprehensive testing of UK e-signature compliance features and public AI assistant. All new features working correctly: (1) Public assistant endpoint accessible without auth, (2) Assistant provides UK-focused answers mentioning Electronic Communications Act 2000 and UK eIDAS, (3) All pricing displays in GBP (£0, £15, £49) with no dollar signs, (4) UK compliance badges present on landing hero, footer, and login page, (5) Floating assistant widget functional on landing page, (6) Settings subscription tab shows GBP pricing, (7) In-app Help assistant still works and quotes GBP, (8) Admin portal and dashboard load correctly. Email verification test failures are EXPECTED (email is now LIVE via Resend, not dev mode).

backend_issues.notes: Email verification tests show 6 failures because email is now LIVE via Resend (dev_mode=false, no dev_code returned). This is EXPECTED behavior per agent_to_agent_context_note and NOT a bug. All new UK/GBP features work correctly.

GBP PRICING: Assistant quotes prices in GBP (£15, £49) and never mentions dollars
BILLING API: GET /api/billing/plans returns currency='gbp' with Pro=15.0, Business=49.0
CHECKOUT API: POST /api/billing/checkout creates Stripe session and payment_transactions record with currency='gbp'
FLOATING WIDGET: Launcher button (data-testid='floating-assistant-toggle') present in bottom-right of landing page
WIDGET INTERACTION: Clicking toggle opens panel (data-testid='floating-assistant-panel'), suggestion chips work, messages display, close button works
LANDING PRICING: /#pricing section shows Free £0, Pro £15, Business £49 with no dollar signs
HERO BADGE: Landing hero badge reads 'UK eIDAS & ECA 2000 aligned'
FOOTER BADGE: Site footer badge reads 'UK eIDAS & ECA 2000 aligned'
LOGIN BRAND PANEL: /login brand panel mentions 'UK eIDAS & Electronic Communications Act 2000'
SETTINGS PRICING: Settings > Subscription tab shows GBP prices (£0, £15, £49) with no dollar signs
UPGRADE BUTTONS: 'Upgrade to Business' button (data-testid='plan-select-business') present and functional
IN-APP ASSISTANT: Settings > Help tab assistant (data-testid='help-ai-chat') works and quotes GBP prices
REGRESSION: Admin login (admin@civicsign.com/Admin1234!) works and loads admin dashboard
